title: HoarePrompt: Structural Reasoning About Program Correctness in Natural Language
abstract: arXiv:2503.19599v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While software requirements are often expressed in natural language, verifying the correctness of a program against such requirements is a hard and underexplored problem. Large language models (LLMs) are promising candidates for addressing this challenge, however our experience shows that they are ineffective in this task, often failing to detect even straightforward bugs. To address this gap, we introduce HoarePrompt, a novel approach that adapts fundamental ideas from program verification to natural language artifacts. Inspired from the strongest postcondition calculus, HoarePrompt employs a systematic, step-by-step process in which an LLM generates natural language descriptions of reachable program states at various code points. translated_title: HoarePrompt：用自然语言对程序正确性进行结构化推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2503.19599v3 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：虽然软件需求通常以自然语言表达，但针对此类需求验证程序的正确性是一个困难且研究不足的问题。大型语言模型（LLM）是解决这一挑战的有希望的候选者，然而我们的经验表明，它们在这项任务中效果不佳，甚至常常无法检测出简单的错误。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了HoarePrompt，这是一种将程序验证的基本思想应用于自然语言工件的新型方法。受最强后置条件演算的启发，HoarePrompt采用一种系统化、逐步进行的过程，其中LLM在代码的各个点生成可达程序状态的自然语言描述。为了处理循环，我们提出了少样本驱动的k归纳法（few-shot-driven k-induction），这是对模型检测中广泛使用的k归纳方法的一种改编。一旦程序状态被描述，HoarePrompt便利用LLM来评估……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: HoarePrompt将程序验证中的最强后置条件演算和k归纳等经典思想引入自然语言领域，通过LLM逐步生成程序可达状态的自然语言描述，从而有效检测程序与自然语言需求之间的错误。
en_tdlr: HoarePrompt adapts classic program verification ideas—strongest postcondition calculus and k-induction—to natural language, using LLMs to systematically describe reachable program states and thereby effectively detect bugs against natural language requirements.
